ai_quote: She said Numeracle uses AI to help identify those fabrications, though she declined to describe the methods in detail.

company.description: Numeracle verifies businesses and links their identities to the phone numbers they use to contact customers, sharing that information with carrier call-screening systems and working to remove incorrect spam labels.
company.name: Numeracle

geography_quote: The McLean, Virginia-based company verifies businesses and links their identities to the phone numbers they use to contact customers.
source_quote: Numeracle has raised $28 million from Edison Partners to help businesses whose calls are incorrectly labeled as spam or blocked by phone carriers
